Ed Staub & Sons has continuously served the energy needs of local communities for over 60 years. We are here to help.

Propane

Ed Staub & Sons has built a reputation of providing high quality, commercial, agricultural, and residential propane services.

Bulk Fuel

To get the job done, you need the right fuel. Whether you just need to fill your tank or need on-site delivery by the truckload.

Cardlock

Ed Staub & Sons/Fuel Commander provides the highest quality fuel management solution for small and large businesses.

Lubricants

The right lubricants are fundamental in extending the life of your equipment! We carry the best brands for your specific needs.

Fuel is Critical.

We deliver the fuel you need, at the best value, to keep you and your business running.
